hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Token launch hook that charges a time-decaying anti-snipe fee on quote-currency buys, starting near 99% at pool open and decreasing linearly over 20 seconds to a configured steady-state rate (1%–10%). Fees are split between a platform and a tracker; swap metadata (trader, referrer, comment) can optionally be supplied via hookData in afterSwap.
